create_pipeline_hunyuandit_differential_: create a HunyuanDiT differential img2img pipeline for text-guided image generation with gradient masks
run_pipeline_differential_img2img: run the HunyuanDiTDifferentialImg2ImgPipeline with a source image, gradient mask, and text prompt to generate a modified image
